body:
Two coordinate-SWAP targets still require exactly **six paid coordinate-CNOT calls for every finite address dimension n ≥ 2 and scalar-register count R ≥ 2**, including free scalar mixing and arbitrarily many restored dirty registers. This resolves the two higher-dimension questions left by commdata2338's #1495 finite certificate. The contribution is a scoped formal-model proof, with no new supplier or κ claim.

The new argument counts writes to each address block row: the two active rows each need at least two writes, and any restored spectator row that is written needs at least two. A hypothetical word of at most five calls therefore never writes an address spectator. Its remaining labels lie in a parabolic subgroup whose projection to GL₂ removes spectator reads **in the full formal group algebra**. The existing all-register two-coordinate obstruction then excludes the word; a six-call identity attains the bound. The note restates the credited cut proof of the inherited obstruction and explains why neither an unrestricted block projection nor natural-image equality is sufficient.

Only `research/two-swap-address-spectators/` is added: the proof, a standard-library verifier, original/actual task card, four exact live source pins, and normal/optimized registered replay.

Validation at **743ddd6275cfd560d9c3e7825c42545152d14e4c** (Windows, CPython 3.12.0, Git 2.47.1):
- Registered normal and optimized replay and metadata/pin validation pass. Finite checks cover 1,280 transitions, 5,120 row-rank bounds, 2,656 single-write checks, 9,792 subgroup products, and 2,996 write-count vectors.
- All 20 complete formal six-call endpoints, their reversals and scalar conjugates pass. All 120 single-call omissions and 12 dirty-only faults reject. Controls expose the invalid whole-group projection, natural-representation kernel and changed rank-two tariff.
- Exact committed-byte comparison and official nine-file export/integrity checks pass. Normal and optimized direct replays also pass from a fresh read-only Git-free export with Git absent from PATH; actual source corruption rejects in both modes and original bytes are restored.
- `python -B scripts/research_selected_baseline.py` returns `PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY`. This is orientation, not a selected-supplier cold replay.

Reproduce: `python -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/two-swap-address-spectators`.

The universal conclusion rests on the written argument; the finite fixtures do not establish its universal quantifiers. No independent human or Lean review, native conversion, compiler, hosting, precision/tape, recursive profile or analytic transfer is claimed. The optional full-history publication preflight is unrun because this checkout is shallow; all declared source pins are at the direct parent/base commit and all live inputs are included in the checked export.

Started from canonical main **cef4b52f2a59009865bf8eabde1be3f159063703**, priority revision 7; upstream refresh before submission remained at that commit. The refreshed overlap snapshot covers 311 open PRs and 4,011 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings (2026-10-23 02:54–02:56 UTC), plus the complete retained top-level scope inventory. No exact overlap was identified within that coverage; arbitrary diffs and unpublished work are outside it. Original card `bit-new-register-model` is preserved with a declared scope change to a negative formal-model screen.

[Canonical claim and result](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1317#discussioncomment-19136566). Credit commdata2338/#1414/#1495, Gareth Davidson/#1333, Ross Richardson/#1989 and the retained GL2 cut corollary, plus the earlier register-model and cut-method authors recorded in the package. Prepared for Mihir Srivastava with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
title: Prove six-call two-SWAP cost with arbitrary address spectators
